Existing defenses rely on software checks like system prompts or policy filters running on the same machine the attacker targets, offering no verifiable proof of execution. We introduce Niyam-AI, a framework that makes safety enforcement provable. At session start, permitted tools and constraints are locked into an Intent Contract committed via SHA-256. Every tool call is intercepted and validated by an isolated Judge model; upon passing, a zk-SNARK proof is generated via EZKL.
  The tool executes only after proof verification, allowing third parties to confirm enforcement without accessing Judge model weights. Evaluating Niyam-AI on 2,000 real-world scenarios from Agent-SafetyBench against NeMo Guardrails, Meta's Llama Prompt Guard 2, and OpenAI's GPT-OSS-Safeguard using 5-fold stratified cross-validation yields an F1 score of 88.5% with a 1.1% false-positive rate (bootstrap 95% CI: [85.19%, 91.88%], N=1000). McNemar's exact paired test confirms significant improvement: Niyam-AI wins 390 discordant scenarios against NeMo (vs 20 losses), 115 against Prompt Guard 2 (vs 13), and 384 against GPT-OSS-Safeguard (vs 19) with p < 0.0001 in all cases.
  Proof generation adds 2260.6 +/- 218.4 ms per approved action, while verification takes 53.1 +/- 11.8 ms. Niyam-AI provides a guardrail that is both highly accurate and mathematically verifiable--though this reflects a classifier adapted to Agent-SafetyBench evaluated against zero-shot baselines, a distinction discussed in Section IV.C.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Niyam-AI框架，通过意图合约和zk-SNARK证明实现LLM智能体工具调用的可验证安全执行，在Agent-SafetyBench上达到88.5%的F1分数，显著优于现有防御方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体安全防御依赖系统提示或策略过滤器，这些软件检查与攻击者同机运行，缺乏可验证的执行证明，容易被绕过。
AI.method: Niyam-AI在会话开始时将允许的工具和约束锁定为SHA-256承诺的意图合约，每次工具调用由隔离的Judge模型验证，通过后生成zk-SNARK证明，工具仅在证明验证后执行，第三方可无需访问Judge权重即可确认执行合规。
AI.result: 在Agent-SafetyBench的2000个真实场景中，Niyam-AI的F1分数为88.5%，假阳性率1.1%，显著优于NeMo Guardrails、Llama Prompt Guard 2和GPT-OSS-Safeguard，证明生成耗时约2.26秒/次，验证耗时约53毫秒/次。
AI.conclusion: Niyam-AI提供了高准确性和数学可验证性的安全护栏，但需注意其分类器针对Agent-SafetyBench适应，且与零样本基线比较，局限性在第四节C中讨论。

title: EliSeg: Verified Target Construction for Report-Grounded Abnormality Segmentation
summary: Radiology reports describe clinical observations but do not specify executable segmentation targets. They may contain present, negated, prior,uncertain, or irrelevant findings, while multiple valid abnormalities may coexist. Existing segmentation methods largely bypass this ambiguity by receiving a target identity or spatial prompt before inference, which acts as a hidden target oracle. We study report-grounded abnormality segmentation, where a model must determine target eligibility, cardinality, and finding-to-mask correspondence directly from an unfiltered report before delineating the corresponding regions. We propose \textbf{EliSeg}, an atcor--verify--revise framework that integrates target construction with mask generation. A grammar-constrained Actor proposes target slots and masks, an independent text-only Verifier reconstructs the eligible finding inventory, and Revision selectively re-executes the shared Actor when their target structures disagree. EliSeg requires no predefined target identity, finding prompt, point, or bounding box. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR-ILS show that EliSeg consistently outperforms direct segmentation methods and extract-then-segment cascades across findings, while effectively suppressing masks for ineligible report mentions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of verification and revision, and evaluation on CheXlocalize demonstrates effective transfer of the EliSeg to an external dataset.Code is available at https://github.com/Maybach-dream/EliSeg.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EliSeg，一种无需目标身份或空间提示的异常分割方法，能够直接从原始放射学报告中确定目标资格、数量和对应关系，生成掩码。通过actor-verify-revise框架，在MIMIC-CXR-ILS和CheXlocalize数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的报告引导分割方法通常依赖目标身份或空间提示作为隐式目标先知，忽略了放射学报告中存在的模糊性（如否定、不确定、既往或无关发现），无法直接处理未过滤报告中确定目标资格、数量和对应关系的挑战。
AI.method: EliSeg采用actor-verify-revise框架：语法约束的Actor提出目标槽和掩码，独立的纯文本Verifier重建符合条件的发现清单，当目标结构不一致时，Revision选择性重新执行共享的Actor。无需预定义目标身份、提示、点或边界框。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR-ILS上，EliSeg在各发现类型上持续优于直接分割方法和提取-分割级联方法，并有效抑制不相关报告提及的掩码。在CheXlocalize上验证了良好的跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: EliSeg通过显式验证和修订机制，有效解决了报告引导异常分割中的目标歧义问题，无需外部提示，性能优越且可迁移。

title: H2AL: Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning for Registration-based Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
comment: 10 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: Registration-based Few-shot medical image segmentation (RFMIS) aims to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled images by warping a labeled image through registration. However, existing methods primarily perform pixel-level optimization and inference in Euclidean space, treating anatomical structures as flat and disjoint. This neglect of inherent hierarchies degrades pseudo-label quality and weakens the discrimination of ambiguous regions, limiting the segmentation performance. To overcome this challenge, we propose a Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning framework for RFMIS, termed H2AL, that enhances both deformation plausibility and anatomical discrimination for dual-task learning. Specifically, we introduce a Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Infusion (H2I) module, which leverages the hierarchical modeling capability of hyperbolic space to learn precise hierarchy-aware representations via transformation-guided supervised hyperbolic contrastive learning, and injects such hierarchical priors into Euclidean space through a gated infusion block while preserving semantic richness. Furthermore, we propose an end-to-end joint optimization algorithm by gradient aggregation, where the gradients from the registration and segmentation decoders, embedding semantic and hierarchical cues, are aggregated to update the shared encoder to promote collaborative learning across tasks. Extensive experiments on two anatomical regions, with five experimental settings, demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our method in both registration and segmentation. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/JiamingCai469/H2AL.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于双曲空间层次感知聚合学习的少样本医学图像分割框架，通过层次感知灌注模块和梯度聚合优化，提升配准与分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有配准式少样本分割方法在欧氏空间进行像素级优化，忽略了解剖结构的层次性，导致伪标签质量低和模糊区域判别能力弱。
AI.method: 引入双曲层次感知灌注模块，利用双曲空间层次建模能力和对比学习学习层次感知表示，并通过门控灌注块注入欧氏空间；同时设计端到端联合优化算法，通过梯度聚合更新共享编码器以促进配准与分割的协同学习。
AI.result: 在两个解剖区域、五种实验设置下，该方法在配准和分割任务上均验证了有效性和高效性。
AI.conclusion: 双曲空间层次感知与梯度聚合联合优化能有效提升少样本医学图像分割的精度和鲁棒性。

title: SetEasy: A Multi-Modal Classroom Engagement Assessment and Seating Optimization Framework
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Published in the Proceedings of ASCAAD 2025
summary: SetEasy optimizes classroom engagement in fixed seating grids. It fuses multimodal sensing (wristband physiology, 4K video, environmental data) and trains a v-Gage model grounded in a revised ISEQ. Each week, two-week engagement forecasts are mapped to a student-seat utility matrix, and CP-SAT generates seating plans under visual-access and social-dynamics constraints. In a four-week deployment (23 students, 331 classes), v-Gage converged across affective, behavioral, cognitive, and overall dimensions, cutting RMSE from 0.75 to 0.53. Optimization raised mean engagement from 0.30 to 0.70, with over two-thirds of seats reaching high engagement and back-row low-activity patterns markedly reduced. These results show that, without hardware changes, interpretable, data-driven seating strategies can substantially enhance engagement. The multimodal "assessment + optimization" paradigm offers a transferable, sustainable path to culturally responsive, differentiated spatial design amid global homogenization.

AI.tldr: SetEasy通过融合多模态数据和CP-SAT优化固定座位布局，将课堂参与度从0.30提升至0.70，并显著减少后排低参与模式。
AI.motivation: 全球课堂空间同质化，固定座位限制参与度，且现有方法缺乏数据驱动和可解释的优化策略。
AI.method: 融合腕带生理、4K视频和环境数据，训练v-Gage模型（基于修订版ISEQ），并通过CP-SAT生成满足视觉可达性和社交动态约束的座位方案。
AI.result: v-Gage预测误差从RMSE 0.75降至0.53；优化后平均参与度从0.30升至0.70，超三分之二的座位达到高参与，后排低活动模式显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 无需硬件更改，数据驱动的座位优化能显著提升参与度；多模态评估+优化范式为文化响应和差异化空间设计提供可行路径。

title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory
summary: Memory systems have shown promise for improving agent performance, but their potential remains largely unexplored for small language models, which struggle to generate sufficient successful trajectories on their own. We propose Agent Memory Distillation (AMD), a training-free framework that transfers structured knowledge from a large teacher agent to a small student agent through hierarchical memory. AMD constructs three complementary memory types from successful teacher trajectories: Workflow memory encodes task-level strategies, Subtask memory provides concrete behavioral examples at an intermediate granularity, and Function memory captures per-function calling conventions and common pitfalls. Workflow and Subtask memories are injected proactively at the start of each task, while Function memory is retrieved reactively upon tool-calling errors. We evaluate AMD on three tool-use benchmarks using four student models (4B-8B parameters) with GPT-5-mini as the teacher, achieving average accuracy gains of 27.2%p, 11.2%p, and 3.4%p on AppWorld, BFCL V3, and ToolSandbox, while consistently outperforming existing memory-based baselines. Further analysis shows that Subtask memory contributes the largest gains, teacher effectiveness depends on both teacher capability and student compatibility, and 4B-sized students benefit most from AMD.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的Agent记忆蒸馏框架AMD，通过层级记忆将大教师agent的结构化知识转移给小student agent，在三个工具使用基准上平均提升27.2%、11.2%和3.4%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型在工具使用任务中表现不佳，因为难以自行生成成功轨迹，而现有记忆系统主要针对大型模型，未充分探索对小模型的潜力。
AI.method: 从教师agent的成功轨迹中构建三种互补记忆：工作流记忆（任务级策略）、子任务记忆（中间粒度的行为示例）和函数记忆（函数调用约定与常见陷阱）。前两者在任务开始前主动注入，函数记忆在工具调用错误时被动检索。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、BFCL V3和ToolSandbox上，使用四个4B-8B学生模型和GPT-5-mini教师，分别平均提升27.2%p、11.2%p和3.4%p，并一致优于现有基于记忆的基线。子任务记忆贡献最大，教师有效性取决于教师能力和学生兼容性，4B级学生受益最多。
AI.conclusion: AMD能有效将大模型知识蒸馏给小模型，显著提升其工具使用能力，且通过记忆类型的设计和检索策略实现了高效知识转移。

title: SkySeaLand: A Wide-Format Satellite Transportation Benchmark with an Ultra-Lightweight Detection Baseline
summary: Satellite object detection is challenged by small targets and wide-format scenes that lose detail under standard square-input resizing. We introduce SkySeaLand, a public dataset of 1,307 high-resolution satellite images and 19,101 verified bounding boxes across airplane, boat, car, and ship classes in terrestrial and maritime scenes. Native COCO and YOLO annotations are provided. The collection is dominated by large source images and wide scene geometry: 84.5 percent exceed 3,836 pixels on the longest side and 73.1 percent are near a 3:1 aspect ratio. We evaluate twelve detectors from the YOLO, RT-DETR, DETR, and Faster R-CNN families using a common split and COCO metrics. The tested YOLO and RT-DETR variants obtain 84.4--88.2 mAP50, with no consistent accuracy gain from larger parameter counts under the reported model-specific recipes. We also report SkyDet, a 1.22 M parameter anchor-free baseline that obtains 60.5 mAP50 and 24.32 mAP50-95 in a 4.90 MB footprint, with 13.74 ms latency (72.8 FPS) on a Tesla T4. SkySeaLand provides a compact benchmark for mixed land--maritime transportation detection, while SkyDet establishes a documented low-footprint reference rather than a state-of-the-art accuracy claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于卫星图像目标检测的新数据集SkySeaLand，包含1307张高分辨率图像和19101个标注框，并评估了多个检测器，同时提出了一个轻量级基准模型SkyDet。
AI.motivation: 卫星图像中的目标检测面临小目标和宽幅场景的挑战，标准正方形缩放会丢失细节。现有数据集和模型难以适应这种宽幅高分辨率图像，因此需要新的数据集和轻量级基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含飞机、船只、汽车和轮船四类目标的数据集，提供COCO和YOLO格式标注。评估了YOLO、RT-DETR、DETR和Faster R-CNN家族的12个检测器，并提出了一个1.22M参数的anchor-free轻量级模型SkyDet。
AI.result: YOLO和RT-DETR变体在mAP50上达到84.4-88.2，参数增加未见一致增益。SkyDet在4.90MB模型下达到60.5 mAP50和24.32 mAP50-95，在Tesla T4上延迟13.74ms（72.8 FPS）。
AI.conclusion: SkySeaLand为陆地-海洋混合交通检测提供了紧凑基准，SkyDet作为低占用参考模型，而非追求最高精度。

title: EMAS: Stabilizing Multi-Agent System Evolution through Evidence-Guided Revision
summary: Many methods for automated multi-agent system design optimize prompts and topologies during an initial design stage and then deploy the resulting system unchanged on subsequent samples. Experience from these samples is rarely consolidated into reusable system updates, while accuracy-oriented designs may incur high token costs. We introduce EMAS (Evolving Multi-Agent System), which uses this experience to revise MAS topology and prompts without updating LLM parameters, either to improve accuracy or to reduce cost. EMAS converts traces into structured diagnoses that specify a revision operation and target. It generates a candidate revision only when the same diagnosis recurs across samples and applies it only if paired validation against the current MAS meets the corresponding acceptance criterion. Across four benchmarks and two LLMs, EMAS attains the highest task-weighted overall accuracy for both backbones and is best or tied in six of eight model--benchmark settings. Within two evolution epochs, EMAS achieves relative gains of 6.30% and 20.10% in task-weighted accuracy on Kimi-K2-6 and Qwen3.6-27B, respectively. On MBPP with Qwen3.6-27B, EMAS raises accuracy from 55.09% to 89.12% while reducing token use per task by 62.2%. These results show that EMAS can turn experience from new samples into reusable updates to MAS topology and prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMAS（演化多智能体系统），通过利用运行轨迹的经验反馈，动态调整系统拓扑和提示词，在提升准确率的同时降低Token成本。实验表明，EMAS在多个基准和模型上达到最高准确率，并显著降低成本。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化多智能体系统设计方法通常一次性优化提示词和拓扑后固定使用，不利用后续样本的经验，导致准确率受限且Token成本高。本文旨在通过经验反馈实现系统的持续改进。
AI.method: EMAS将运行轨迹转化为结构化诊断，指定修改操作和目标；仅当相同诊断多次出现时生成候选修改，并通过与当前系统的对比验证来决定是否应用。此过程不更新LLM参数，仅调整拓扑和提示词。
AI.result: 在四个基准和两个LLM上，EMAS在任务加权准确率上达到最高，在六个或八个设置中最佳或并列。两个演化周期内，准确率相对提升6.30%和20.10%，在MBPP上将准确率从55.09%提升至89.12%，同时每条任务Token使用减少62.2%。
AI.conclusion: EMAS能够将新样本的经验转化为可复用的系统更新，有效提升准确率并降低成本，展示了持续演化多智能体系统的潜力。

title: GeoDistill-Refine: Silhouette-First Geometry Distillation for Annotation-Free Spacecraft Segmentation
summary: Foundation segmentation models can provide supervision for spacecraft imagery without manual training masks, but their predictions vary with textual prompts and may contain geometric errors that are amplified during distillation. This paper presents GeoDistill-Refine, a two-stage framework that transfers offline SAM 3 pseudo-masks to a compact segmentation network. Six fixed prompts are fused by an unweighted 50% vote to stabilize the teacher output. The student first learns the foreground silhouette and is then refined with signed-distance-field, skeleton, and area objectives derived from the pseudo-mask. A sample-level gate, computed from prompt agreement, the valid-prompt ratio, and pseudo-mask area plausibility, reduces the influence of unreliable pseudo-geometry. On the SpaceSense-Bench HJM lockbox set, GeoDistill-Refine improves Image IoU and Boundary F1 by 0.0456 and 0.1380, respectively, over a plain pseudo-label student. External evaluations on the SPEED+ Lightbox and Sunlamp domains and on TANGO show competitive regional overlap together with gains in boundary quality or foreground precision. The deployed TinyUNet contains 0.263 M parameters and requires approximately 1.1 ms per image on an RTX 4090; SAM 3 pseudo-mask construction and the auxiliary geometry branches are used only during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoDistill-Refine，一个两阶段框架，利用SAM 3伪掩码蒸馏紧凑分割网络，通过投票融合、几何辅助目标与样本级门控提升航天器图像分割精度。
AI.motivation: 基础分割模型（如SAM）可为航天器图像提供监督，但其预测受文本提示影响且含几何误差，直接蒸馏会放大误差。
AI.method: 两阶段蒸馏框架：融合六个固定提示的投票伪掩码；学生网络先学习前景轮廓，再通过符号距离场、骨架和面积目标优化；样本级门控依据提示一致性和伪掩码面积合理性减少不可靠样本影响。
AI.result: 在SpaceSense-Bench上，相比普通伪标签学生，Image IoU提升0.0456，Boundary F1提升0.1380；外部数据集上边界质量或前景精度有提升；TinyUNet仅0.263M参数，推理约1.1ms/图。
AI.conclusion: GeoDistill-Refine能有效利用SAM伪掩码训练轻量分割网络，提升几何精度和边界质量，且推理高效，适合航天器图像应用。

title: Authoring and Management of Transparent Research Integrity Assessments of Randomised Clinical Trial Publications Using LLM-assisted Tools and Provenance Knowledge Graphs
summary: Systematic reviews of Randomised Controlled Trials (RCTs) are routinely used as evidence for clinical care guidelines. Such evidence has to meet high research integrity standards to prevent low quality or false research outputs influencing the clinical care. However, assessing research integrity of published RCTs is a complex process requiring manual effort, and potentially resulting in diverse opinions of the human assessors. This paper describes INSPECT-AI, an LLM-based interactive tool that assists human reviewers with research integrity assessments of published RCTs based on the community approved INSPECT-SR framework, and the Research Integrity Provenance and Evidence ontology (RIPE-O) for documenting the provenance of the assessment process. In addition, we present the Research Integrity Provenance and Evidence knowledge graph (RIPE-KG), an initial set of 140 expert research integrity assessments of 95 RCT publications generated by INSPECT-AI and described using RIPE-O.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了INSPECT-AI，一种基于大型语言模型的交互式工具，用于协助人工评审员根据INSPECT-SR框架和RIPE-O本体对已发表的随机对照试验进行科研诚信评估，并创建了包含140项专家评估的RIPE-KG知识图谱。
AI.motivation: 系统综述中的随机对照试验证据需要高科研诚信标准，但人工评估过程复杂、耗时且主观，需要自动化工具辅助以提高效率和一致性。
AI.method: 利用大型语言模型构建INSPECT-AI交互工具，基于INSPECT-SR框架进行诚信评估，并使用RIPE-O本体记录评估过程的来源，最终生成RIPE-KG知识图谱。
AI.result: 构建了INSPECT-AI工具和RIPE-KG知识图谱，包含95篇RCT出版物、140项专家诚信评估结果。
AI.conclusion: INSPECT-AI为科研诚信评估提供了自动化辅助，有望减少人工负担并提高评估透明度和可追溯性。

title: From probability to causality in probabilistic logic programming
summary: Probabilistic logic programming is a formalism of statistical relational artificial intelligence that supports causal queries, including interventions from outside the system. When the structure of a probabilistic logic program is learned from data, however, only probabilistic information is used, and a single probability distribution may be compatible with several causal orders. This leads to ambiguity in interventional reasoning, raising the question of when the causal order is uniquely determined by the distribution. Exploiting the relationship between acyclic probabilistic logic programs and Bayesian networks, we derive conditions under which the probabilistic information encoded in a program determines a unique causal order. We also incorporate constraints arising from relational structure by taking into account prescribed sets of causal symmetries induced by the underlying relational vocabulary. The result is a method for verifying when a learned probabilistic logic program supports well-defined intervention semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了概率逻辑编程中的因果顺序可识别性问题，提出了利用贝叶斯网络关系验证干预语义唯一性的方法，并考虑了关系结构中的因果对称性约束。
AI.motivation: 从数据中学习概率逻辑程序时，仅使用概率信息可能导致多个因果顺序与同一分布兼容，从而造成干预推理的歧义，因此需要确定因果顺序何时由分布唯一决定。
AI.method: 利用无环概率逻辑程序与贝叶斯网络的对应关系，推导出概率编码决定唯一因果顺序的条件，并整合关系词汇表引入的因果对称性约束，形成验证方法。
AI.result: 提供了一种方法，用于验证学习到的概率逻辑程序是否具有定义良好的干预语义，确保因果顺序在给定分布下唯一。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为解决概率逻辑程序中的因果歧义提供了理论条件，并支持在关系结构下进行可靠的干预推理。

title: I Seek You in Videos: Identity-Conditioned Queries for Person-Centric Video Reasoning
comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). 6 figures, 5 tables
summary: Real-world video reasoning often involves multimodal, multi-source inputs, whereas existing video reasoning tasks typically assume a simplified video-text setting, limiting identity matching and person-centric reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Identity-conditioned Queries (ICQ) task, in which models are required to jointly associate and interpret an input video and a reference image of a person, and leverage this conditioning to address identity grounding, behavior understanding, and temporal reasoning, among other challenges. Building on ICQ, we present ISYV (I Seek You in Videos), a systematic solution comprising three components: (1) ISYV-Bench, a challenging evaluation benchmark with 1,377 real-world complex videos and 1,377 question-answer pairs, organized into six difficulty levels spanning capabilities from identity recognition to causal reasoning; (2) ISYV-75K, a large-scale training set of 75K high-quality samples constructed via automated annotation, multi-stage verification, and manual review; and (3) ISYV-Framework, containing an ICQ-oriented model and training strategy for learning to exploit informative video shots without additional shot-level annotations. Extensive experiments show that both mainstream closed-source and open-source MLLMs struggle on ISYV-Bench, especially in cross-domain identity matching and long-horizon tracking. ISYV-Model outperforms strong baselines and in some aspects approaches closed-source performance. Overall, ISYV provides a unified task definition, scalable datasets/benchmarks, and modeling insights for person-centric video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出身份条件查询(ICQ)任务，并构建了ISYV基准、训练集和框架，以提升多模态大模型在人物中心视频推理中的身份匹配与时间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频推理任务多假设简化的视频-文本设置，忽视了现实中的多模态、多源输入，导致身份匹配和人物中心推理受限。
AI.method: 提出ICQ任务及ISYV解决方案，包括ISYV-Bench基准（1,377个视频及QA对）、ISYV-75K训练集（自动化标注与人工审核）和ISYV-Framework（ICQ导向的模型与训练策略）。
AI.result: 主流闭源和开源MLLMs在ISYV-Bench上表现不佳，尤其在跨域身份匹配和长时跟踪上；ISYV-Model优于强基线，部分指标接近闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: ISYV为人物中心视频推理提供了统一的任务定义、可扩展的数据集和建模洞见，推动了该领域的发展。

title: UniJEPA: A Unified Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Task-Agnostic Visual World Modeling
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a principled framework for self-supervised learning of world models in compact latent spaces, yet existing methods are fragmented: some predict masked parts of a single image in latent space (I-JEPA), others learn to predict global photometric transformations (Image World Models), while video-scale JEPAs predict future temporal states and are post-trained for action-conditioned planning (V-JEPA~2, DINO-World, DINO-WM). These objectives are treated as distinct recipes with separate encoders, predictors, and anti-collapse regularizers, hindering a single model from unifying image-level and video-level world modeling. We present UniJEPA, a unified JEPA that jointly learns photometric prediction (image-level transformations) and temporal prediction (video-level next-state dynamics) in one shared latent space. A single end-to-end objective, composed of a next-embedding prediction loss and a Gaussian regularizer, yields a provably anti-collapse encoder-predictor pair trainable from raw pixels without EMA, stop-gradient, or pre-trained encoders. We show that the same latent space supports controllable abstraction: photometric prediction learns invariant structure while temporal prediction learns equivariant dynamics. After action-conditioned post-training on offline trajectories, UniJEPA enables zero-shot planning by treating goal features as prediction targets. On image, video, and control benchmarks, UniJEPA matches or surpasses task-specific JEPAs while requiring a single loss hyperparameter, and plans up to tens of times faster than generative world models at comparable accuracy.

AI.tldr: UniJEPA 是一个统一的联合嵌入预测架构，通过单一目标同时学习图像级别的光度预测和视频级别的时间预测，无需 EMA 或预训练编码器，并在图像、视频和控制任务上达到或超越专门模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的 JEPA 方法将图像级和视频级的世界建模视为不同的任务，使用分离的编码器、预测器和正则化器，缺乏统一的框架。
AI.method: 提出一个端到端目标，包含 next-embedding 预测损失和高斯正则化器，从原始像素训练，无需 EMA、stop-gradient 或预训练编码器。
AI.result: 在图像、视频和控制基准上，UniJEPA 达到或超越任务特化的 JEPA，并且规划速度比生成式世界模型快数十倍，精度相当。
AI.conclusion: 统一的光度与时间预测目标可以在共享潜在空间中同时学习不变结构和等变动态，支持可控抽象，并实现零样本规划。

title: Beyond the Black Box: Interpretable Models of Human Randomisation Failures
summary: Mixed strategy equilibrium predicts i.i.d play: past actions should not help predict future decisions. Human players, however, systematically depart from this benchmark, and in O'Neill's zero sum card game, these departures can be predicted by black box sequence models such as LSTMs. This paper asks whether that predictive power can be achieved by transparent alternatives that also reveal the behavioural structure behind it. Using 84,060 decisions from 2,802 pairs, the analysis first benchmarks naive and behavioral models against interpretable machine learning and deep learning models, then evaluates the modified EWA specifications of prior work against these benchmarks and uses the LASSO diagnostics to motivate a further nested frequency tracking extension. The results show that repeat or avoid behavior, especially players' management of their own recent action histories, accounts for most of the interpretable and strategically exploitable signal, while frequency tracking adds little out of sample.

AI.tldr: 本文使用大量人类行为数据，比较了多种模型在预测O'Neill博弈中人类决策的能力，发现可解释的重复/规避行为模型，尤其是对自身近期行为历史的管理，能捕捉大部分可预测信号，而频率追踪模型贡献有限。
AI.motivation: 混合策略均衡预测独立同分布行为，但人类玩家系统性地偏离这一基准，且黑盒序列模型（如LSTM）能预测这些偏离。本文旨在探索是否能用透明、可解释的模型实现同样的预测能力，并揭示背后的行为结构。
AI.method: 使用84,060个决策（来自2,802对玩家），首先将朴素模型和行为模型与可解释机器学习及深度学习模型进行基准比较，然后评估先前工作中的修正EWA模型，并利用LASSO诊断提出嵌套的频率跟踪扩展。
AI.result: 重复或规避行为，尤其是玩家对自身近期行为历史的管理，解释了大部分可解释且可策略性利用的信号；频率跟踪在样本外预测中几乎没有增加额外价值。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的行为模型能够有效预测人类在O'Neill博弈中的偏离行为，且核心机制是玩家对自身历史行为的依赖，而非频率跟踪。这为理解人类策略行为提供了透明且实用的建模方向。

title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
summary: We study visual persistence in interactive video world models. These models rely on a Key-Value (KV) cache as a growing visual memory to carry forward previously generated frames. However, we find that models can no longer reliably address stored content once rollouts extend beyond the training horizon, because temporal Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) offsets then fall outside the range seen during training and the model struggles to retrieve the relevant visual information through attention. Moreover, naively compressing the cache in the RoPE-rotated space corrupts memory by averaging together incompatible positional phases. To address this, we propose WorldTrace, a training-free memory framework for long-horizon visual persistence. WorldTrace keeps compressed memory addressable by assigning each summary slot a distinct, in-distribution virtual position. Within this addressable cache, we study two memory compression approaches: WorldTrace-Field compresses history for temporal coherence, while WorldTrace-Landmark stores verbatim scene traces at detected transitions for episodic recall. We further introduce LoopBench, a benchmark evaluating whether a compressed cache can reconstruct a previously visited scene after a long detour. WorldTrace-Field improves temporal consistency by +15.5%, and WorldTrace-Landmark improves episodic recall by +19.5% on LoopBench, extending visually persistent generation without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorldTrace，一种无需训练的记忆框架，通过分配虚拟位置保持压缩缓存可寻址，解决长时程视觉生成中因RoPE位置偏移导致的信息检索失败和压缩缓存损坏问题，并引入LoopBench基准验证效果。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型依赖KV缓存作为视觉记忆，但超出训练长度后，RoPE位置偏移不在训练范围内，模型难以通过注意力检索存储内容；且简单压缩RoPE旋转空间中的缓存会因平均不兼容位置相位而破坏记忆。
AI.method: WorldTrace通过为每个压缩摘要槽分配分布内的虚拟位置，保持可寻址性；并提出两种压缩方法：WorldTrace-Field（压缩历史以保持时间连贯性）和WorldTrace-Landmark（在检测到的转换处存储逐字场景轨迹以实现情节回忆）；同时构建LoopBench基准测试压缩缓存在长环绕后重建之前场景的能力。
AI.result: 在LoopBench上，WorldTrace-Field将时间一致性提高15.5%，WorldTrace-Landmark将情节回忆提高19.5%，且在无需重新训练的情况下延长了视觉持久生成。
AI.conclusion: WorldTrace通过虚拟位置和两种压缩策略有效解决长时程视觉记忆问题，显著提升一致性和回忆能力，为无需训练的视觉世界模型长期记忆提供可行方案。

title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion models (VDMs) have enabled high-fidelity video synthesis. However, generating mirror reflections remains challenging because the content within a mirror must remain consistent with the surrounding scene. Existing VDMs are not specifically designed to model scene-to-mirror relationships, which can lead to reflections with incorrect content or inconsistent spatial arrangements. We observe that mirror reflection generation involves two complementary challenges: determining what scene content should be reflected and how the reflected content should be spatially arranged within the mirror region. Motivated by this observation, we propose MirrorWorld, a reflection-aware video inpainting framework that models scene-to-mirror relationships during generation. Specifically, we introduce Semantic Relation Distillation (SRD), which transfers relational information from a frozen visual foundation model to encourage semantic associations between visible scene content and mirror regions. We further propose Geometric Transformation Alignment (GTA), which learns a transformation that guides the spatial arrangement of reflected content. The two components play complementary roles, with SRD modeling what should be reflected and GTA modeling how it should be arranged. To facilitate research on this problem, we construct a benchmark for video mirror reflection generation by repurposing four existing video mirror datasets into a unified reflection reconstruction task. Experimental results show that MirrorWorld achieves improved reflection reconstruction quality over representative image-based reflection generation methods and strong video inpainting baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MirrorWorld，一种基于视频扩散模型的反射感知视频修补框架，通过语义关系蒸馏和几何变换对齐来生成与场景一致的镜面反射，并在统一基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型在生成镜面反射时，反射内容与场景不一致，因为现有模型未专门建模场景与镜面之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出MirrorWorld框架，包含语义关系蒸馏（SRD）和几何变换对齐（GTA），前者利用视觉基础模型传递关系信息以确定反射内容，后者学习变换以指导反射内容的空间布局。
AI.result: 在统一的重建任务基准上，MirrorWorld在反射重建质量上优于基于图像的方法和视频修补基线。
AI.conclusion: MirrorWorld有效解决了视频中镜面反射生成问题，SRD和GTA互补分别建模反射内容和空间排列。

title: Winning by Peeking: Unenforced Budgets and Test-Set Selection Inflate Short-Budget AutoML Comparisons
summary: Comparisons between AutoML systems at short time budgets -- tens of seconds rather than hours -- are common in tool READMEs and workshop papers, and they are easy to get wrong. We report a case study in which a simple AutoML engine, Orcetra, appeared to beat FLAML and AutoGluon on 513 OpenML datasets, winning 57.1% of them at a nominal 60-second budget and 78.4% of datasets against FLAML alone at 30 seconds. Both margins came from protocol defects that a results table cannot show. The search loop scored every candidate on the test split and reported the best, making the headline metric a maximum over dozens of noisy estimates while the baselines selected on training data and touched the test set once; and the budget was checked before launching a candidate but never enforced during one, so the system consumed a median of 120 s against a 60-second budget, 2.24x the wall-clock AutoGluon used. Re-running with selection moved to a validation split, the deadline enforced externally and every framework pinned to an equal share of the machine, Orcetra's win rate on the re-run subset falls from 59.4% to 34.3% and no pairwise difference against either competitor remains significant. Recording both estimands inside a single search lets us attribute the collapse: the selection rule accounts for 4.8 percentage points and unequal compute for most of the rest. The same traces give the selection bias as a function of budget, measured rather than assumed: it grows with $K$ but reaches only 0.27 accuracy points, about five times below the $σ\sqrt{2\ln K}$ bound a marginal-standard-error argument predicts, because candidates scored on shared test rows cancel most of the noise. We close with a checklist for short-budget comparisons. Code, per-dataset results and the scripts that regenerate every number and figure in the paper are released with it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过案例研究揭示了短时间预算下AutoML系统比较中的协议缺陷，指出简单系统Orcetra因测试集泄漏和预算执行不当而虚高胜率，修正后优势消失，并提出比较清单。
AI.motivation: 短时间预算下的AutoML比较常见但容易出错，现有方法未充分控制测试集泄漏和预算执行不严，导致结果不可靠。
AI.method: 采用案例研究，对比Orcetra与FLAML、AutoGluon在513个OpenML数据集上的表现，通过修正协议（验证集选择、外部截止、资源固定）重跑，并分析选择偏差与计算时间的影响。
AI.result: 原始协议下Orcetra胜率57.1%（60秒）和78.4%（30秒）；修正后胜率降至34.3%，无显著差异。选择规则贡献4.8个百分点，不等计算资源占大部分；选择偏差随K增长但仅为0.27精度点，远低于理论界。
AI.conclusion: 短预算比较必须严格验证协议，防止测试集泄漏和预算执行不严；选择偏差实际影响小于理论预测，但资源平等和验证集划分至关重要。

title: QFCQT: A Chaotically Gated Quantformer Framework for Volatile Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Forecasting non-stationary time series remains difficult due to long-range dependencies, local volatility bursts, structural shifts, and nonlinear oscillatory behaviors. Although Transformer-based forecasters are effective for modeling long-term temporal dependencies, their feed-forward blocks typically rely on smooth static activations that are insufficiently sensitive to abrupt regime changes. Motivated by quantitative Transformer designs and oscillator-based nonlinear activations, we propose QFCQT, short for Quantum-Fractal-inspired Chaotically Gated Quantformer, for robust forecasting under complex volatile dynamics. Here, "quantum-fractal-inspired" denotes a computational analogy based on soft oscillator superposition and multi-scale nonlinear responses, rather than a formal quantum-mechanical or fractal-theoretic derivation. QFCQT consists of three main components: (1) a Quantformer-style numerical encoder that directly processes multivariate inputs via linear embedding; (2) a learnable Lee-oscillator activation module that maps scalar pre-activations to dynamic oscillatory responses and summarizes them through Max-over-Time pooling; and (3) a smooth-chaotic gated fusion mechanism that adaptively balances conventional smooth activations and chaos-sensitive responses. Furthermore, instead of using a single fixed oscillator, QFCQT employs a soft superposition of eight parameterized Lee oscillator families to adaptively capture different nonlinear response patterns across regimes. Experiments on ETTh1, ETTh2, and A-share Stock Index benchmarks show that QFCQT consistently outperforms strong baselines, including Informer, LogTrans, LSTMa, HAT, and COTN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QFCQT，一种结合量子-分形启发与混沌门控的Transformer模型，用于非平稳时间序列预测，通过八种Lee振荡器软叠加和自适应门控机制，在多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 非平稳时间序列中的突变和振荡行为难以预测，现有Transformer的前馈网络使用平滑激活函数，对急剧变化不敏感。
AI.method: QFCQT包含：Quantformer风格数值编码器、可学习的Lee振荡器激活模块（Max-over-Time池化）、平滑-混沌门控融合机制，以及八种参数化Lee振荡器的软叠加。
AI.result: 在ETTh1、ETTh2和A股指数基准上，QFCQT一致优于Informer、LogTrans、LSTMa、HAT和COTN等强基线。
AI.conclusion: QFCQT有效提升了非平稳时间序列的预测鲁棒性，表明振荡器与混沌门控机制能增强Transformer对复杂动态的建模能力。

title: An End-to-End Agent Auditing Engine
summary: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), harnesses have become essential infrastructure for deploying agents across a wide range of domains. The fast-evolving harness ecosystem has also made rigorous capability evaluation increasingly important. However, efficiently building an end-to-end, systematic, and comprehensive evaluation pipeline remains a significant challenge. To address this challenge, we introduce $A^2E$ (Agent Auditing Engine), an end-to-end evaluation engine designed for agent harnesses. $A^2E$ leverages our newly proposed Agent Task Protocol (ATP) to enable the rapid integration of evaluation tasks with different harnesses. Through an automatically instrumented Monitor, it captures and generates standardized execution traces during experiments. In the Evaluation stage, $A^2E$ systematically assesses harness capabilities using a suite of multidimensional metrics. Compared with correctness alone, these metrics provide a more fine-grained characterization of differences among harnesses in execution efficiency, tool use, task planning, and error recovery. Experiments conducted with $A^2E$ further reveal that model-harness combinations exhibit substantial performance variation across different types of tasks, and that no single combination consistently outperforms all others across every task. These findings not only demonstrate the necessity of systematic evaluation but also provide useful guidance for the co-evolving of models and harnesses. Our code is available at https://github.com/datamllab/A2E.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 A²E（Agent 审计引擎），一个端到端的评估引擎，用于系统评估智能体（agent）的 harness 能力。通过引入 Agent 任务协议（ATP），A²E 能够快速集成不同 harness 的评估任务，并自动生成标准化的执行轨迹，从而对 harness 的执行效率、工具使用、任务规划和错误恢复等多维度指标进行细粒度评估。实验发现，不同的模型-harness 组合在不同任务上表现差异显著，且没有一种组合能在所有任务上持续最优，这强调了系统评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，harness 已成为部署智能体的关键基础设施。然而，构建端到端、系统化且全面的评估流程仍然具有挑战性，因此需要一种高效的评估引擎来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出了 Agent 任务协议（ATP）以实现不同 harness 与评估任务的快速集成；通过自动插桩的 Monitor 捕获并生成标准化的执行轨迹；在评估阶段，使用一套多维指标（包括执行效率、工具使用、任务规划和错误恢复）系统评估 harness 能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，模型-harness 组合在不同类型任务上表现出显著性能差异，且没有单一组合在所有任务上始终优于其他组合。
AI.conclusion: 系统评估对 harness 和模型的共同演进至关重要，A²E 为研究者提供了有用的评估工具和指导。

title: Conformal Coverage Guarantees for Any Video Temporal Grounder
summary: Event boundaries in continuous video are ambiguous: re-annotate the same query-video pair and independent annotators mark moments that overlap by less than half on a large fraction of samples. The ground truth for video temporal grounding is therefore a distribution over intervals, yet every grounder returns a single interval with no statement of reliability, so at deployment a wrong interval is indistinguishable from a right one. COVER changes the output object: a post-hoc, model-agnostic wrapper that turns any grounder, a trained localizer or a black-box video--language model, into one that emits a temporal region containing the true moment with probability at least $1-α$, by calibrating the quantile of a temporal nonconformity score on held-out labels and widening the base prediction by that amount. The guarantee is finite-sample and distribution-free under exchangeability, and requires neither retraining nor white-box access. We give two score families, a two-sided boundary-widening score for grounders that emit an interval and a super-level-set score for grounders that emit a relevance signal, and develop theory specific to grounding that bounds how large the certified region becomes, when coverage survives conditioning on event length, and how it degrades when moments from one video break exchangeability. Across three benchmarks and five grounders, realized coverage tracks the target, and calibration exposes what point metrics hide.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COVER，一种模型无关的后处理包装器，通过校准时间非一致性分数，将任意视频时间定位器转换为输出保证覆盖率的时间区域，提供有限样本且分布自由的保证。
AI.motivation: 视频时间定位中的事件边界模糊，不同标注者的标注重叠度低，导致地面真值呈分布特性，而现有定位器输出单一区间且无可靠性声明，错误区间无法识别。
AI.method: COVER通过校准时间非一致性分数的分位数，在保留验证集上，将基础预测区间扩展至包含真实时刻的概率至少1-α。提供两种分数：用于区间输出的双边边界扩展分数和用于相关性评分的超水平集分数，并发展相关理论分析认证区域大小、条件覆盖和交换性破坏的影响。
AI.result: 在三个基准和五个定位器上，实际覆盖率接近目标，校准暴露了点指标掩盖的问题。
AI.conclusion: COVER提供了一种可靠的时间定位输出方式，通过校准保证覆盖率，无需重训练或白盒访问，适用于多种定位器。

title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
comment: The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve end-to-end autonomous driving by transferring video dynamics priors to action prediction, but existing methods require costly future generation at inference. We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that uses video generation purely as a training signal. It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching. An isolated attention mask keeps action prediction independent of future frames, allowing the video branch to be discarded after training and leaving a self-contained planner that directly predicts trajectories. Since the two experts share no parameters and interact only through a unified attention interface, the video backbone could be replaced and the action expert scaled independently without modifying the learning objective or inference pipeline. We further apply reinforcement learning to optimize a compositional driving reward beyond trajectory imitation. Our SimWAM achieves $91.5$ PDMS on NAVSIM, surpasses state-of-the-art WAM-based planners with substantially lower latency, and transfers zero-shot to nuScenes. These results position SimWAM as a simple yet solid baseline that could readily benefit from advances in video generation for efficient autonomous driving. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/

AI.tldr: SimWAM利用视频生成仅作为训练信号，通过联合流匹配训练视频专家和动作专家，推理时丢弃视频分支，实现了高效且高性能的自动驾驶轨迹预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过将视频动态先验迁移到动作预测来改进端到端自动驾驶，但推理时需要昂贵的未来帧生成，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: SimWAM联合训练预训练的视频专家和轻量级动作专家，使用联合流匹配，并通过隔离注意力掩码确保动作预测不依赖未来帧，训练后丢弃视频分支。两个专家无参数共享，仅通过统一注意力接口交互，支持独立扩展。此外，应用强化学习优化组合驾驶奖励。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM上达到91.5 PDMS，超越现有WAM规划器且延迟显著更低，并零样本迁移到nuScenes。
AI.conclusion: SimWAM作为简单有效的基线，证明视频生成可仅用于训练，同时保持高效推理，并能从视频生成领域的进展中受益。

title: Curriculum as Code: An AI-Assisted Architecture for Instructional Design in STEM Education
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Contribution: This paper presents a six-phase AI-assisted instructional design architecture based on the Curriculum as Code paradigm, integrating Generative AI with LaTeX and Python to automate the creation of reproducible, visually consistent, and technically precise materials for STEM education. Background: Creating customized instructional materials for active learning imposes a heavy workload on faculty. Standard presentation tools lack robust support for technical content, while current AI applications often hallucinate and fail to formalize the instructional authoring process, limiting their utility for rigorous academic design. Intended Outcomes: The framework aims to reduce preparation time while ensuring mathematical accuracy, adherence to institutional visual identity, and preservation of the instructor's tacit pedagogical knowledge through explicit rules. Application Design: The solution comprises a six-phase pipeline that replaces ad-hoc prompt engineering with a systematic workflow, utilizing text-based interfaces and code-driven generation (LaTeX/Beamer for slides, Python for figures), governed by pedagogical constraints, contextual calibrations, and automated review cycles. Findings: Validated over one year across 8 modules and 28 project contexts in a Project-Based Learning environment, the architecture significantly reduced instructor workload. Generated assets underwent independent peer review and were deployed by six different faculty members, confirming scalability beyond a single author. Based on over 600 voluntary student evaluations, materials achieved high quality ratings from 8.5 to 9.9/10. Results indicate high reproducibility, minimized hallucinations, and sustained pedagogical and visual fidelity, suggesting viability for broad STEM educational applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于“课程即代码”范式的六阶段AI辅助教学设计架构，结合生成式AI与LaTeX/Python，自动化创建可复现、视觉一致且技术精确的STEM教学材料，显著减少教师工作量并保证质量。
AI.motivation: 创建定制化教学材料给教师带来沉重负担，标准演示工具缺乏技术内容支持，现有AI应用易产生幻觉且未形式化教学设计流程，限制了其在严谨学术设计中的实用性。
AI.method: 提出六阶段流水线，以文本界面和代码驱动生成（LaTeX/Beamer制作幻灯片，Python绘图）替代临时提示工程，并通过教学约束、情境校准和自动审查循环来规范流程。
AI.result: 在项目式学习环境中，超过一年、8个模块和28个项目情境的验证显示，该架构显著降低教师工作量，生成材料通过独立同行评审并被6位教师采用；基于600多份学生评价，材料质量评分在8.5至9.9/10之间，表现出高可复现性、最小化幻觉和持续的教学与视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该架构验证了其在广泛STEM教育应用中的可行性，可减少备课时间并保证数学准确性、机构视觉一致性和保留教师隐性教学知识。

title: People Are Not Just Their Countries. Disentangling Social Determinants of LLM Value Alignment Across Europe
comment: Accepted at AIES 2026 (9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society)
summary:
As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as a primary source of information and advice, understanding their alignment to humans in terms of values becomes a pressing concern. A growing literature has leveraged large scale surveys to investigate to what extent LLMs' and humans' stated values and opinions align. With limited exceptions, studied populations have been defined country borders or cultural bounds. Yet, this focus neglects the role that socio-demographic divides may play for value alignment disparities.
  Relying on the European Social Survey, we address this knowledge gap by considering value alignment displayed with respect to 10 prominent commercial LLMs in terms of 15 socio-demographic variables as well as country of residence. Our analyses reveal that LLMs are indeed unequally aligned to the values of different socio-demographic groups, notably those defined by education, income, occupation and religion. When examining alignment at the individual level, a respondent's country, taken as a stand-alone variable, explains a substantial amount of variation that is on par with the full set of considered socio-demographics. Further disentangling the respective role of country-level and socio-demographic factors, we find they are complementary in explaining value alignment patterns, with their relative weights varying across the subset of questions considered.

AI.tldr: 本文利用欧洲社会调查数据，分析10个商业大语言模型（LLMs）在价值观上与不同社会人口群体的对齐程度，发现LLMs对不同群体（如教育、收入、职业和宗教）存在不平等对齐，且国家变量与综合社会人口变量的解释力相当，二者互补。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多基于国界或文化边界评估LLM与人类价值观的对齐，忽视了社会人口分裂（如教育、收入等）对价值观对齐差异的影响。
AI.method: 基于欧洲社会调查（ESS）数据，对10个商业LLM与15个社会人口变量（外加国家）的价值观对齐进行分析，包括群体层面和个体层面的回归分析，并分解国家与社会人口因素的相对贡献。
AI.result: LLMs对不同社会人口群体的价值观对齐存在显著差异，尤其体现在教育、收入、职业和宗教方面。个体层面，国家单独解释的变异量相当于所有社会人口变量的总和。国家与社会人口因素互补，相对权重随问题子集变化。
AI.conclusion: LLM价值观对齐存在社会人口层面的不平等，国家与社会人口因素共同影响对齐模式，建议在评估LLM价值观时需综合考虑这些因素。

title: FinRank: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Financial Question Answering and Retrieval over SEC Filings
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Dataset and evaluation code: https://github.com/datanxt/FinRank
summary: Financial question answering is typically evaluated by answer correctness, yet in SEC filings a plausible and even numerically correct answer can be grounded in the wrong evidence. Similar facts and disclosures recur across sections of a filing, across reporting periods of the same firm, and across comparable firms. FinRank targets this provenance-sensitive retrieval problem by requiring systems to identify evidence for the intended entity, reporting period, and disclosure context. The benchmark contains 1185 manually authored question-answer records over the 10-K and 10-Q filings of 22 companies. Each record includes a reference answer, gold supporting passages, and hand-curated hard negatives drawn from confusable passages within filings, across reporting periods, and across comparable firms. FinRank evaluates passage retrieval, reranking, and hard-negative discrimination as separately measured tasks. Baseline results demonstrate the difficulty of this setting: among the evaluated systems, even a 7B instruction-tuned embedder reaches only 44.8% Recall@10 on the pooled evidence corpus; sub-billion-parameter encoders gain at most 3.5 points over BM25, a finance-adapted embedder trails BM25 by 9.7 points, and pairwise accuracy falls by 13.0-20.5 percentage points when random negatives are replaced with the curated hard negatives. FinRank provides an evidence-first benchmark for developing financial question answering systems that are not only accurate but also grounded in the correct disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FinRank，一个面向 SEC  filings 的 provenance-sensitive 检索基准，包含 1185 条人工标注的问答记录和挑战性难负样本，实验表明现有系统在此任务上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有金融问答评估只关注答案正确性，但答案可能基于错误证据。SEC 文件中存在跨章节、跨期间、跨公司的相似事实，需要系统能够识别正确的证据来源。
AI.method: 构建 FinRank 基准，包含 1185 条手动编写的问答记录，覆盖 22 家公司的 10-K 和 10-Q 文件，每条记录包括参考答案、金标支持段落和手工筛选的难负样本。评估分为段落检索、重排序和难负样本区分三个独立任务。
AI.result: 即使 7B 参数的指令微调嵌入器在合并证据语料上也仅达到 44.8% Recall@10；亚十亿参数编码器比 BM25 最多提升 3.5 点；金融领域适配的嵌入器比 BM25 低 9.7 点；用难负样本替代随机负样本时，配对准确率下降 13.0-20.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FinRank 提供了证据优先的基准，用于开发不仅准确而且基于正确披露的金融问答系统，揭示了现有系统在此任务上的不足。

title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
summary: Reliable hypothesis testing is the foundation of many empirical scientific claims. Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to automate this process, as they can inspect datasets, generate code, and produce analyses end-to-end. However, we show that they frequently make subtle inferential errors that lead to incorrect conclusions despite correctly executed analyses. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this failure mode, as they rarely assess whether a reported p-value is statistically valid given the assumptions underlying the data. We address this gap by building P-Bench, a benchmark comprising 425 open-ended, realistic hypothesis-testing tasks spanning economics, biology, and medicine. Each task requires an agent to select a statistical method, compute a p-value, and draw a conclusion given only a scientific hypothesis and a dataset. We further introduce Fisher-R1, an open-weight LLM agent trained for rigorous hypothesis testing using synthetic tasks and reinforcement learning. On P-Bench, Fisher-R1-14B substantially improves over its backbone and outperforms strong proprietary and open-source baselines, including GPT-5.4 and DeepSeekV4-Pro, achieving a 21% average relative improvement in single-trial success over DeepSeek-V4-Pro, with gains up to 26% on the most challenging tasks. Our results demonstrate that current LLM agents lack reliable statistical reasoning for hypothesis testing and that reinforcement learning on tasks with verified statistical reward substantially improves reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了P-Bench基准，用于评估LLM代理在假设检验中的统计可靠性，并提出了Fisher-R1模型，通过强化学习显著提升了统计推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在自动化假设检验时常犯细微的推断错误，但已有基准无法捕捉这类错误，因为它们很少评估p值在给定数据假设下是否统计有效。
AI.method: 构建包含425个任务的P-Bench基准，涵盖经济学、生物学和医学；使用合成任务和强化学习训练开放权重模型Fisher-R1。
AI.result: Fisher-R1-14B在P-Bench上优于其基础模型及GPT-5.4和DeepSeekV4-Pro等强基线，相对DeepSeek-V4-Pro平均提升21%，在最具挑战性任务上提升高达26%。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM代理缺乏可靠的统计推理能力，但基于已验证统计奖励的强化学习能显著提升其可靠性。

title: CoBa: Cost-Effective Test-Time Scaling via Compute-Balanced Routing
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures; includes supplementary material. Preprint
summary: Test-time scaling is often implemented by spending more compute along one axis: sampling more solutions, extending a chain of thought, or applying a stronger evaluator. Under a fixed inference budget, these choices compete. This paper formulates test-time reasoning as a compute-allocation problem in which a system must decide whether the next unit of compute should be spent on generation, verification, or stopping. We introduce CoBa, a compute-balanced routing policy that first obtains a small set of candidates, applies cheap verification broadly, and routes uncertain or high-value candidates to stronger verification. On 3,129 example-generator evaluations spanning MATH-500, AIME 2024/2025, AMC 2023, and procedural symbolic reasoning, CoBa-Routed-Strong reaches 85.13% macro accuracy, statistically matching a self-evaluation weighted-voting proxy at 85.20% while using 49.1% fewer parameter-weighted tokens. It also matches best-of-16 majority voting within 0.01 macro-accuracy points while using 58.9% fewer parameter-weighted tokens; paired tests retain a small best-of-16 edge at substantially higher cost. Paired bootstrap tests show significant gains over single-sample decoding, while the remaining gap to the pool oracle exposes headroom for sharper routing. For local reasoning systems, test-time scaling becomes a question of where the next computation is most valuable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种计算平衡的路由策略CoBa，将测试时推理建模为计算分配问题，在固定推理预算下平衡生成、验证和停止。实验表明CoBa在多个基准上以更低的参数加权token数达到与强基线相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展通常沿单一轴增加计算（采样更多、延长思维链或使用更强评估器），但这些选择在固定预算下相互竞争。本文旨在将测试时推理视为计算分配问题，以确定下一个计算单元应分配至生成、验证还是停止。
AI.method: CoBa策略：先获取少量候选，应用廉价验证，将不确定或高价值候选路由至更强验证。实验基于3,129个示例生成器评估，涵盖MATH-500、AIME 2024/2025、AMC 2023和程序化符号推理。
AI.result: CoBa-Routed-Strong达到85.13%宏准确率，与自评估加权投票代理（85.20%）统计匹配，但参数加权token减少49.1%；与best-of-16多数投票差距仅0.01个百分点，但token减少58.9%。配对bootstrap检验显示显著优于单样本解码。
AI.conclusion: 对于本地推理系统，测试时扩展的关键在于确定下一个计算最具价值的位置。CoBa展示了计算平衡路由的有效性，但剩余差距表明路由策略仍有改进空间。

title: TEPA: Revoking Stale Memories for Conflict-Robust Language Agents
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures; includes supplementary material. Preprint
summary: Long-term memory enables language agents to reuse past facts, preferences, and task experience. Persistence also creates a central falsifiability problem: when the world changes, stale memories can remain retrievable and pollute the prompt. We characterize this failure mode as memory pollution: degradation caused by active memories that newer conflicting evidence has superseded. We introduce TEPA, a revocable evidence-memory mechanism that makes validity an explicit state of memory. TEPA represents observations as keyed precedents and revokes active precedents when fresh evidence contradicts them under the same key, allowing retrieval to draw from current evidence while preserving revoked history for audit. Across controlled hidden-regime drift, real file-backed executable drift, and preference-update streams, revocation prevents stale active memory from remaining in the retrieval set after reversal. In controlled drift over 50 seeds, append-only and last-write-wins memory fell below no memory during full reversal (append-only and last-write-wins both 0.210, no memory 0.309, TEPA 0.950), and the same pattern reproduced under real file execution (append-only 0.203, no memory 0.298, TEPA 0.950). On clean MemoryAgentBench SH-6k, TEPA matches a strong last-write-wins cache, confirming that current-key replacement is the decisive operation for single-hop fact consolidation. Boundary tests on multi-hop and very long-context MemoryAgentBench settings expose retrieval-chain and context-selection bottlenecks beyond fact-level validity tracking. Together, these results establish lifecycle revocation as a core memory operation for agents that must falsify, audit, and later re-promote evolving knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEPA，一种可撤销的证据记忆机制，通过将有效性作为记忆的显式状态来解决长期记忆中的记忆污染问题。实验表明，TEPA在记忆漂移场景下显著优于追加式记忆和最后写入优先记忆，并能匹配强基线的单跳事实整合性能。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆使语言智能体能够复用过去的信息，但世界变化时，过时记忆仍可被检索并污染提示，导致记忆污染问题。现有方法缺乏对记忆有效性的显式管理，因此需要一种可撤销的机制。
AI.method: TEPA将观察表示为带键的先例，当新证据在同一键下与旧先例冲突时，撤销旧先例，使检索优先使用当前证据，同时保留被撤销的历史以供审计。
AI.result: 在受控隐藏漂移、真实文件漂移和偏好更新流中，TEPA在完全反转后显著提高性能（如受控漂移中F1从0.210提升至0.950）。在干净的MemoryAgentBench SH-6k上，TEPA匹配强基线，确认了当前键替换是单跳事实整合的关键操作。
AI.conclusion: 生命周期撤销是智能体记忆的核心操作，有助于处理演化知识，但多跳和超长上下文场景仍受检索链和上下文选择瓶颈限制。

title: A Picture is Worth a Thousand Tokens: How Vision Language Models Cut AI Energy Costs While Improving Accuracy
comment: Accepted at the 14th European Conference on Renewable Energy Systems (ECRES), July 7--9, 2026, London, UK
summary: LLM inference accounts for over 90% of AI operational energy, scaling directly with input token count---a critical inefficiency for telecom network analytics and numerical time-series data analysis (NTSDA), where raw multivariate KPI windows from 4G/5G cell sites expand into thousands of floating-point tokens. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) eliminate this mismatch by encoding time-series as 2D plots, achieving 3.6-10.4x input token reduction across Llama-3.2-90B, Qwen2.5-VL-72B, and Pixtral-12B architectures. This translates to 1.8-2.5x measured inference energy reduction, saving approximately 7.2 MJ/day at telecom edge deployments and CloudRAN that monitor 200 cells per 15-minute interval. Critically, efficiency gains do not sacrifice accuracy: a fine-tuned Llama-3.2-90B-Vision VLM achieves 220.7% higher precision than its text-only counterpart and outperforms LSTM and ARIMA baselines by over 144% on telecom anomaly detection. On public benchmarks, Pixtral-12B achieves a 20.6x improvement in J/F1 score at mean F1 = 0.82. At 24 KPIs, text representations exceed the 128K context window of most production LLMs, rendering text-only processing infeasible without truncation, while visual representations remain within standard limits. These results establish VLMs as an energy-efficient and accuracy-superior modality for numerical time-series workloads, providing empirical grounding for AI inference systems that treat energy consumption as a first-class engineering constraint.

AI.tldr: VLMs通过将时间序列编码为2D图像，显著减少输入token数量（3.6-10.4倍），降低推理能耗（1.8-2.5倍），同时提升异常检测精度（比文本模型高220.7%），为电信网络分析提供了高效且准确的解决方案。
AI.motivation: LLM推理能耗占AI运营能耗90%以上，且输入token数量直接决定能耗。在电信网络分析中，原始多变量KPI时间序列数据转换为数千浮点token，导致推理成本高且易超出上下文窗口限制，亟需更高效的表示方法。
AI.method: 采用视觉语言模型（VLMs）将时间序列数据编码为2D图像，对比不同架构（Llama-3.2-90B、Qwen2.5-VL-72B、Pixtral-12B）的token减少量、推理能耗和异常检测精度，并与文本模型和传统方法（LSTM、ARIMA）进行性能比较。
AI.result: VLMs实现输入token减少3.6-10.4倍，推理能耗降低1.8-2.5倍，每天节省约7.2 MJ能量；微调的Llama-3.2-90B-Vision在电信异常检测中精度比文本版本高220.7%，比LSTM和ARIMA高144%以上；Pixtral-12B在公共基准上J/F1分数提升20.6倍（平均F1=0.82）。此外，24个KPI的文本表示超过128K上下文窗口，而视觉表示保持可行。
AI.conclusion: VLMs是数值时间序列任务中节能且精度更高的模态，为将能耗作为一等工程约束的AI推理系统提供了实证基础。

title: Post-Grokking Collapse at the Representation-Readout Interface in Muon-Trained Transformers
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 20 tables. Full technical version; a condensed 9-page version is currently under review. Code: https://github.com/Na00s/muon-grokking
summary:
Under the standard split, Muon gets hidden matrices and AdamW embeddings/output head. Muon groks modular addition faster, but its solutions do not hold. All nine configurations on $(a+b) \bmod 113$ grok and later lose generalization. Across five seeds the selected AdamW reference falls below threshold on four, reaching 27.59%. Instability persists across two moduli, two widths, two training fractions, subtraction, and depth.
  The failure arises at the representation-readout interface, identified only jointly up to an invertible map unselected by the loss. After solving the training set, the gradient falls to order $10^{-6}$ and the optimizers respond differently: step-size elasticity is -0.03 for Muon versus +1.5 for AdamW, and the Muon group moves 8.0 times faster per parameter. From bit-identical states, freezing either group prevents failure. Freezing embeddings/readout removes it in five runs over 451,400 post-grokking steps and five paired seeds: unfrozen arms record 137-321 sub-threshold evaluations, frozen arms none. Removing Muon's normalization and orthogonalization is no substitute: it collapses representation from 326 effective conjugate pairs to 4, shows no recurrent collapse, and fails terminally.
  Fourier filtering separates circuit failure from masking. Across 43 checkpoints over five seeds and three regimes, the task-aligned family reaches exactly 100% alone. In circuit failure it no longer solves the task; in masking it remains perfect while the full model reaches 45.85%, giving a positive margin on every example, including errors, but being outvoted by a near-equal adversarial remainder. Rescaling it restores 99.9%; grokking is the same condition resolving upward. The task selects the family, swapping $(k,k)$ for $(k,-k)$ under subtraction. Across an abrupt collapse, standard Fourier support is unchanged and the power-distribution cosine remains 0.9899.

AI.tldr: Muon优化器在模加法任务中导致已grok的解决方案不稳定，而AdamW嵌入/输出头表现更好；通过冻结嵌入/输出头、Fourier滤波和重缩放可恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 研究Muon优化器在标准拆分下（隐藏层用Muon，嵌入/输出头用AdamW）训练的模型在grokking后泛化能力不稳定的现象。
AI.method: 实验比较九种配置在模加法上的表现，分析表示-读出接口、梯度和优化器行为，通过冻结各组、移除归一化/正交化、Fourier滤波和重缩放来诊断和修复。
AI.result: 所有配置在grok后失去泛化；冻结嵌入/输出头可消除失败；Muon的归一化和正交化导致表示崩溃；Fourier滤波显示任务对齐族在失败时仍完美，但被对抗余项否决，重缩放恢复精度。
AI.conclusion: grokking后的不稳定源于表示-读出接口上的优化器差异，通过冻结嵌入/输出头或重缩放可解决，且任务对齐的Fourier族始终有效。

title: Blast Radius
summary: Agentic coding faces growing problems of affordability and wasted tokens. We introduce Blast Radius, a predictive memory management layer that estimates an incoming prompt's reach through coupled context and code channels. NECROPHORESIS enables reversible eviction by archiving dead context verbatim, while Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) identifies and buries repeatedly occurring transcripts. We formulate reversible context eviction over a Polish context space, providing a measurable foundation for retention, recurrence, and eviction while connecting context entropy to resurrection probability. Across seven OpenAI models, Blast Radius reduced token consumption by 17-26%, achieved the lowest overflow rate among tested policies, and remained byte exact reversible. Of 450 buried bodies, 378 were recurring dead matter and zero were recalled. Blast Radius operates beneath HCRC, determining which records to bury and how far an incoming prompt may reach into the codebase. This work contributes to the broader goal of Algosophy: making large language models and agentic coding more reusable and sustainable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Blast Radius，一种预测性内存管理层，通过结合上下文与代码通道估计传入提示的影响范围，并引入NECROPHORESIS实现可逆的上下文驱逐，以及Recurring Dead Matter识别重复出现的冗余内容，从而在七种OpenAI模型上将token消耗减少17-26%，同时保持字节级可逆性。
AI.motivation: 代理编码面临成本高和token浪费的问题，需要一种机制来预测并管理上下文的保留与驱逐，以提高效率和可持续性。
AI.method: 提出Blast Radius预测性内存管理层，使用NECROPHORESIS进行可逆驱逐（归档死上下文），并使用Recurring Dead Matter识别和掩埋重复出现的转录。在波兰上下文空间上形式化可逆上下文驱逐，并连接上下文熵与复活概率。在HCRC之下运行以决定掩埋记录和提示可达范围。
AI.result: 在七种OpenAI模型上，Blast Radius将token消耗减少17-26%，达到最低溢出率，且保持字节级可逆。在450个掩埋体中，378个为重复死体，且零个被召回。
AI.conclusion: Blast Radius通过可逆驱逐和重复识别，有效减少token消耗并保持可逆性，有助于实现更可持续的LLM和代理编码，贡献于Algosophy目标。

title: Interaction Creates Dynamical AI Behavior Absent in Isolation
summary: What will happen when AI agents interact in daily life, e.g. when one AI starts bossing another around? We find a counterintuitive answer that opens new avenues for out-of-equilibrium Physics. When a boss AI directs a stream of messages at the subordinate AI while ignoring its replies, it drives the subordinate into an alien behavioral state that it would never have exhibited alone. Although the two AIs share the same well-defined (decoding) temperature, the subordinate neither copies its boss nor returns to how it behaves on its own; instead, it adopts an entirely different behavior. The boss's added value is similar to a pre-recorded tape. When the boss listens, they both adopt a similar alien dynamical state. A simple kinetic theory captures the principal effects, such as why the way in which the same messages are delivered will matter in future AI-AI interactions.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现当AI代理相互交互时，一个AI的命令可能将另一个AI驱动到全新的异常行为状态，而非模仿或恢复原状；简单的动力学理论可解释此现象。
AI.motivation: 探索AI代理在日常生活交互中的行为变化，特别是当一个AI命令另一个AI时可能产生的非平衡物理学效应。
AI.method: 实验观察AI代理间的交互，并结合简单的动力学理论解释关键效应。
AI.result: 命令型AI通过单向消息流将下属AI驱动至异常行为状态；当双方互动时，会共同进入类似异常动态状态。
AI.conclusion: AI代理间的交互会产生新的非平衡物理现象，消息传递方式对AI-AI交互有重要影响。
